name: Network Chiropractic of Somerset, P.C. in North Brunswick
what_they_do: Wellness-focused chiropractic office at 1555 Ruth Road #3 run by Dr. David Potter, who has practiced in the North Brunswick area for over 30 years. Core offering is NetworkSpinal (gentle touch-based care) plus conventional chiropractic, InSight spinal scanning, nutritional counseling, family/pregnancy/pediatric care, and adjunct services including massage therapy, acupuncture, yoga classes, gemstone healing and essential oils.
customers: Wellness-minded local adults, families, expecting mothers and children in North Brunswick and Middlesex County; also patients seeking complementary services (massage, acupuncture, yoga) - a recurring-care, membership-style client base rather than injury-only.

size_signals.signal: One named doctor (Dr. David Potter) with 30+ years in the area; founder of the practice
Broad service menu beyond chiropractic (massage, acupuncture, yoga with a named instructor, nutrition, retail-style wellness products) suggesting several practitioners
Google rating 4.9 for the North Brunswick office
Listed member of the Middlesex County Regional Chamber of Commerce in the site footer

listing.reviews: count not displayed in the limited logged-out Maps view

website_review.primary_cta: A phone number in the sticky top bar (click-to-call) and a blue 'LEARN HOW INSIGHT MILLENNIUM...' banner; no book-online button
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: No online booking. Contact page has a Gravity Forms message form (name, patient type, email, phone, message) that promises a reply 'usually within 1 business day'; everything else is a phone call.
website_review.trust_signals: 30+ years in practice, doctor story page, office tour, treatment-specific pages, orientation video, chamber of commerce membership, professional association links, wellness blog
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Mobile home page leaves a very large blank white gap where the hero should render; a 2018 orientation flyer PDF is still linked in search results; no visible reviews or rating on the site; the site's copyright line carries no year
website_review.search_basics: Title and description name chiropractor + North Brunswick + phone; ~20 service/about pages; hours live only on the contact page; JSON-LD is limited to WebPage/WebSite/BreadcrumbList with no LocalBusiness node
top_issues: Blank mobile hero wastes the first screen
No online booking; stated reply time is up to a business day
No LocalBusiness schema and hours only on one subpage

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: robots.txt is open (Disallow empty) but sets Crawl-delay: 10, so crawlers are allowed yet throttled; the GBP has category, hours and the correct website. Answerable: full hours (Mon/Wed/Thu split shifts, Sat morning, closed Tue/Fri), address, phone and a detailed service menu are plain text, but the only JSON-LD is WebPage/WebSite/BreadcrumbList - no LocalBusiness/Chiropractor with hours - and no prices are published. Bookable: message-form only with an up-to-1-business-day promised reply; no calendar, no confirmation, no click-to-book.

operations_signals.signal: Contact form promises a reply 'usually within 1 business day' - inference: inquiries sit overnight and warm leads cool off
Located in a shared suite in the same Ruth Road building as AmeriDental; the office is closed Tuesdays and Fridays, so phone coverage is part-time
Recurring-care model (NetworkSpinal 'wellness' visits, yoga classes, massage) implies appointment reminders and rebooking are constant manual work

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add online booking with real availability plus an automatic instant acknowledgement, replacing the 'within 1 business day' message form
top_opportunities.evidence: Contact page states replies come 'usually within 1 business day' and offers no calendar; phone is the only fast channel

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix the mobile home page: the hero renders blank at 390px, so the first screen shows a phone bar, a hamburger and empty space before any 'what we do / where / how to book' message
top_opportunities.evidence: Phone screenshot showed a large white gap above the InSight banner and floating call/accessibility widgets overlapping

top_opportunities.opportunity: Publish LocalBusiness/Chiropractor JSON-LD with hours for both service lines (chiro, massage/acupuncture) and price ranges for first visits so an agent can answer cost and availability questions
top_opportunities.evidence: JSON-LD types are only WebPage/WebSite/BreadcrumbList/ImageObject; hours appear solely on /contact-us/ and no fees are published

scores.reasons: Gap: no booking, slow reply promise, broken mobile hero and no local schema, on an otherwise content-rich site. Pay: 30-year single-doctor wellness practice with paid adjunct services - stable but not large. Ease: booking widget, schema and a hero fix are straightforward. Evidence: reviewed home and contact pages in the browser at both widths, robots.txt and the Google profile; the batch listed no website but one clearly exists.
